content: Use pnpm workspace YAML with apps/* and packages/* globs. Name all packages with @melotech/* scope for consistency.
Each package uses its own tsconfig.json extending root, with rootDir: src and outDir: dist. All packages are ESM (type: module).
Docker Compose uses expose instead of ports for web service to avoid host port conflicts in Coolify. Healthchecks on postgres and redis with service_healthy conditions for dependent services.

name: smoke-test-bootstrap
description: Every new package gets a smoke test immediately. The test imports the package index and verifies the exported VERSION constant. This confirms workspace aliases resolve and the package compiles before any real logic is added.

name: centralized-platform-contracts
description: Shared platform contracts live in @melotech/shared, and runtime config derives platform credit env names from SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS instead of duplicating platform lists.

content: Committed .env.example files should show provider variable names and safe defaults, but real API keys should stay as placeholders.
Phase docs require every AI provider to validate an explicit model env variable together with base URL and API key; provider implementations should not hard-code model names.

name: billing-credit-store
description: Phase billing keeps credit pricing and balance mutations in @melotech/billing behind an injected CreditStore; tests use an in-memory transactional store so wallet, ledger, reservation, capture, release, and analytics rules can be verified without a running database.

title: Use Prisma 7 generated client pre-scripts
rationale: Prisma 7 requires datasource URLs in prisma.config.ts and a driver adapter. The db package ignores packages/db/src/generated and regenerates the typed client before build, test, and typecheck so generated code is not committed.

name: generation-prompt-enrichment
description: Prompt enrichment for generations lives in @melotech/shared as a pure helper, while the db repository maps audience input to persisted rawPrompt, enrichedPrompt, region, ageRange, and gender fields before queueing can read the request.
Root pnpm test previously let package tests race same-package builds. @melotech/db build and test both ran prisma generate into src/generated/prisma, causing transient ENOENT.
resolution: Make test depend on same-package build as well as dependency builds by using turbo test dependsOn [build, ^build].

name: ai-structured-output-reliability
description: AI structured output reliability lives in @melotech/ai: platform generators should call the StructuredOutputService with a Zod schema and injected AIAdapter, while provider code remains isolated behind AIAdapter.

content: AI providers must validate provider-specific base URL, API key, and model env variables before use; Ollama uses OLLAMA_BASE_URL, OLLAMA_API_KEY, and OLLAMA_MODEL.

title: Use OpenAI SDK for Ollama generation
rationale: Ollama exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, so @melotech/ai uses the official OpenAI TypeScript SDK with a normalized /v1 base URL. SDK retries are disabled because StructuredOutputService owns deterministic retry counts.

name: platform-generator-registry
description: Platform generators in @melotech/ai implement the shared PlatformGenerator interface, depend only on StructuredOutputService, and register through PlatformGeneratorRegistry so adding a platform requires a new generator plus registry registration.

name: user-scoped-semantic-cache
description: Semantic fallback cache keeps embedding provider logic in @melotech/embeddings behind EmbeddingAdapter, stores cache rows through @melotech/db SimilarResultCacheRepository, and searches only same-user plus same-platform entries before applying similarity threshold and same-region preference.

content: When implementing a BullMQ worker in a TypeScript monorepo, extract the job handler as a standalone function (createJobHandler) so unit tests can validate payload rejection and processing without instantiating a real Worker or connecting to Redis.

For worker processor tests that verify final generation status (completed/partial/failed), use shared mutable state between mocked repositories so platform output updates are visible when the processor reloads the generation for finalization.

name: in-memory-event-publisher
description: Implement an InMemoryEventPublisher alongside the RedisEventPublisher in the realtime package. This makes worker processor tests deterministic and fast because they do not need a real Redis connection to assert event publishing behavior.

name: queue-producer-interface
description: Define a GenerationQueueProducer interface in the queue package so API routes and tests depend only on the contract, not on BullMQ types. The BullMqGenerationQueueProducer implements the interface and can be swapped with a mock that records jobs in memory.

name: lazy-dependency-getters
description: Use factory functions instead of module-level singletons for deps that read env vars. This prevents Next.js build crashes when env vars are missing during static page generation. Example: getCreditService() instead of export const creditService.

name: prisma-credit-store-bridge
description: When billing logic needs a production store implementation, create a PrismaCreditStore that implements the CreditStore interface using Prisma . Use as-casts for Prisma create inputs to avoid fighting generated type complexity. Keep the mapLedgerEntry private method to normalize Prisma JSON fields back to the domain type.

name: injectable-service-functions
description: Extract core API route logic into pure async functions that accept deps and userId as parameters. Route handlers become thin wrappers that call requireUserId() and inject real deps. Tests pass mock objects directly without module-level vi.mock() blocks. This avoids Next.js headers-outside-request-scope errors in tests.

name: redis-fixed-window-rate-limiter
description: Use Redis INCR + EXPIRE for per-user fixed-window rate limiting. Key pattern: keyPrefix + userId. Set EXPIRE only when current count equals 1 after INCR, so the window auto-resets. Throws a domain-specific RateLimitExceededError with statusCode 429 so the API error handler can map it cleanly.

name: tailwind-v4-theme-tokens
description: Use Tailwind CSS v4 @theme directive in globals.css to register custom design tokens as utility classes. No tailwind.config.js needed. Map semantic tokens like --color-bg-primary and --color-border-subtle so components stay readable and themeable.

name: typed-auth-session-wrapper
description: When Better Auth's inferred useSession type references private package paths and breaks Next.js build checks, export a typed wrapper function instead of the raw hook. The wrapper casts the runtime return shape to a stable AuthSession interface so callers do not need type assertions.

name: minimal-svg-bar-chart
description: For simple usage charts in a dashboard, prefer a minimal flex-based SVG bar chart over heavy chart libraries. Use div bars with percentage heights, title tooltips, and short date labels. Keeps bundle small and charts responsive on mobile.

name: polling-sse-fallback
description: For realtime credit balance updates, combine SSE event listening with a 10-second polling fallback. The hook updates immediately from SSE events and refreshes from the REST endpoint as a safety net when the connection drops or on page load.

content: Keep UI primitive components (Button, Card, Input, Badge, Select) under 100 lines each. Use forwardRef for ref forwarding. Accept className via a cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) so overrides merge cleanly. Store primitives in components/ui/ and page-specific components in components/<feature>/.

name: worker-configured-generation-wiring
description: Worker production dependency wiring must pass parsed @melotech/config retry and similarity values into platform generators and SimilarResultService; otherwise package defaults remain active despite env validation.

name: client-wallet-update-event
description: Use a small client-side wallet-updated CustomEvent helper when dashboard pages mutate credits outside the shell so useWallet consumers, including TopNav, update immediately instead of waiting for the polling fallback.

name: bullmq-full-redis-url-options
description: Build BullMQ Redis connection options from the complete REDIS_URL, including username, password, and database number, so API producers and workers target the same Redis instance and logical DB.

name: visible-worker-platform-failures
description: When worker platform generation fails, persist safe errorMessage values and render them on platform cards. Also log the generation id, platform, and safe public error in the worker so provider/config failures are diagnosable without querying the database.

name: ollama-json-mode
description: For OpenAI-compatible Ollama chat completions used by structured platform generators, request response_format json_object so models are less likely to return prose or markdown that fails schema validation.
Ollama Cloud chat models may reject OpenAI response_format json_object even through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, causing provider request failures before schema validation can run.
resolution: Do not send response_format for Ollama. Enforce JSON-only output through platform-specific system prompts, user prompt output contracts, repair prompts, and verbose structured-output logs.

name: structured-output-debug-logs
description: For structured AI generation debugging, log platform-labeled system prompts, user prompts, raw model responses, provider errors, and validation failures at the StructuredOutputService boundary where retries and repairs are coordinated.

name: nested-provider-error-diagnostics
description: When provider adapters wrap SDK errors in safe public errors, structured-output logging should recursively include nested cause name, message, status, code, and type in worker logs so local debugging can identify provider-side failures without exposing secrets to API responses.
